**Best pick: [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2).** Its 2,073.6 Wh capacity is the strongest option in the results for keeping a reptile heater running through a longer outage. The cited estimate is about **a day for a 100 W ceramic heat emitter on a thermostat**; a lower-wattage heat mat should last longer, though actual runtime depends on how often the thermostat switches the heater on. [Source and estimates](https://dealectric.com/power-station-to-keep-reptile-heat-on-in-a-power-outage)

For a shorter backup or smaller heat mat, the **BLUETTI Elite 30 V2** is a smaller option: the results estimate roughly **6–8 hours for a 24 W heat mat**. [Details](https://dealectric.com/power-station-to-keep-reptile-heat-on-in-a-power-outage)

Check your heater’s wattage and the station’s AC output before buying. Use the heater with its **thermostat**, and insulate the enclosure to help retain warmth; Petco also recommends insulation as part of outage preparation. [Petco’s reptile outage advice](https://www.petco.com/pet-education/reptile/general/caring-for-your-pet-reptiles-during-a-power-outage)
